f3_program: collection("rocky.crafts", "craft", "market", source("his handmade crafts"))
member("rocky.crafts", "rocky.crafts.jewelry", source("selling jewelry at $30 each"))
member("rocky.crafts", "rocky.crafts.painting", source("paintings at $100 each"))
observe(at("rocky.crafts.jewelry.unit_price", "initial"), 30, "dollar_per_item", source("jewelry at $30 each"))
observe(at("rocky.crafts.painting.unit_price", "initial"), 100, "dollar_per_item", source("paintings at $100 each"))
add("increase_jewelry_price", "rocky", at("rocky.crafts.jewelry.unit_price", "current"), 10, source("increase the price of jewelry by $10 each"))

add("increase_painting_price", "rocky", at("rocky.crafts.painting.unit_price", "current"), fraction(at("rocky.crafts.painting.unit_price", "current"), 20, 100), source("the cost of each painting by 20%"))
collection("buyer.purchase.crafts", "craft", "buyer", source("two pieces of jewelry and five paintings"))
transfer("buyer_take_jewelry", "buyer", "rocky.crafts.jewelry", "buyer.purchase.jewelry", 2, source("takes two pieces of jewelry"))
transfer("buyer_take_paintings", "buyer", "rocky.crafts.painting", "buyer.purchase.paintings", 5, source("five paintings"))
member("buyer.purchase.crafts", "buyer.purchase.jewelry", source("two pieces of jewelry"))
member("buyer.purchase.crafts", "buyer.purchase.paintings", source("five paintings"))
query("value", at("buyer.purchase.total_price", "current"))
assumptions: “Cost of each painting” continues the preceding sale-price context.

f3_program: collection("business.startup_contributions", "contribution", "business", source("Robi and Rudy contributed money to start a business"))
observe(at("robi.contribution.dollar_amount", "startup"), 4000, "dollar", source("Robi contributed $4000"))

transfer("robi_contribution", "robi", at("robi.money.dollar_amount", "current"), at("business.startup_capital.dollar_amount", "current"), at("robi.contribution.dollar_amount", "startup"), source("Robi contributed $4000"))

transfer("rudy_contribution", "rudy", at("rudy.money.dollar_amount", "current"), at("business.startup_capital.dollar_amount", "current"), at("rudy.contribution.dollar_amount", "startup"), source("Rudy contributed 1/4 more money than Robi"))

sum_relation(at("rudy.contribution.dollar_amount", "startup"), at("robi.contribution.dollar_amount", "startup"), fraction(at("robi.contribution.dollar_amount", "startup"), 1, 4), source("Rudy contributed 1/4 more money than Robi"))
member("business.startup_contributions", at("robi.contribution.dollar_amount", "startup"), source("Robi contributed $4000"))
member("business.startup_contributions", at("rudy.contribution.dollar_amount", "startup"), source("Rudy contributed 1/4 more money than Robi"))
partition("business.startup_contributions", "business.startup_contributions.total_dollar_amount", source("the total amount"))
produce("business_profit", "business", at("business.money.dollar_amount", "current"), "business.profit.dollar_amount", source("they made a profit of 20 percent of the total amount"))
percent_of("business.profit.dollar_amount", "business.startup_contributions.total_dollar_amount", 20, source("a profit of 20 percent of the total amount"))
collection("business.profit_shares", "profit_share", "robi_and_rudy", source("share the profits equally"))

transfer("distribute_profit_to_robi", "robi_and_rudy", at("business.money.dollar_amount", "current"), at("robi.money.dollar_amount", "current"), at("robi.profit_share.dollar_amount", "distribution"), source("share the profits equally"))

transfer("distribute_profit_to_rudy", "robi_and_rudy", at("business.money.dollar_amount", "current"), at("rudy.money.dollar_amount", "current"), at("rudy.profit_share.dollar_amount", "distribution"), source("share the profits equally"))
member("business.profit_shares", at("robi.profit_share.dollar_amount", "distribution"), source("Robi and Rudy"))
member("business.profit_shares", at("rudy.profit_share.dollar_amount", "distribution"), source("Robi and Rudy"))
partition("business.profit_shares", "business.profit.dollar_amount", source("share the profits equally"))
same(at("robi.profit_share.dollar_amount", "distribution"), at("rudy.profit_share.dollar_amount", "distribution"), source("share the profits equally"))
query("value", at("robi.profit_share.dollar_amount", "distribution"))
assumptions: “The total amount” refers to the two startup contributions; Robi's share represents the equal per-person amount requested.

f3_program: observe(at("company.reportable_segments.food_care.assets_allocated.revised", "2018"), 1914.4, "million_dollar", cell("Food Care", "2018"))

offset(at("company.reportable_segments.food_care.assets_allocated.revised", "2018"), at("company.reportable_segments.food_care.assets_allocated.unrevised", "2018"), 372.9, "million_dollar", source("Assets allocated to Food Care were understated by $372.9 million"))
query("value", at("company.reportable_segments.food_care.assets_allocated.unrevised", "2018"))
collection("sandy.purchased_safe_moon_tokens", "safe_moon_token", "sandy", source("Sandy bought 1 million Safe Moon tokens"))
observe(at("sandy.purchased_safe_moon_tokens.count", "before_split"), 1000000, "safe_moon_token", source("1 million Safe Moon tokens"))
collection("sandy.siblings", "person", "sandy.family", source("She has 4 siblings"))
observe(at("sandy.siblings.count", "current"), 4, "count", source("She has 4 siblings"))
fraction_of(at("sandy.safe_moon_tokens.kept.count", "after_split"), at("sandy.purchased_safe_moon_tokens.count", "before_split"), 1, 2, source("keep half of them to herself"))

sum_relation(at("sandy.purchased_safe_moon_tokens.count", "before_split"), at("sandy.safe_moon_tokens.kept.count", "after_split"), "sandy.safe_moon_tokens.distributed.count", source("keep half of them to herself and divide the remaining tokens among her siblings"))

transfer("distribute_remaining_tokens", "sandy", at("sandy.purchased_safe_moon_tokens.count", "current"), at("sandy.siblings.safe_moon_tokens.count", "current"), "sandy.safe_moon_tokens.distributed.count", source("divide the remaining tokens among her siblings"))
collection("sandy.siblings.safe_moon_token_shares", "safe_moon_token_share", "sandy.siblings", source("divide the remaining tokens among her siblings"))
partition("sandy.siblings.safe_moon_token_shares", "sandy.safe_moon_tokens.distributed.count", source("divide the remaining tokens among her siblings"))

quotient_relation(at("sandy.siblings.each.safe_moon_tokens.count", "after_split"), event_field("distribute_remaining_tokens", "quantity"), at("sandy.siblings.count", "current"), source("divide the remaining tokens among her siblings"))
query("difference", at("sandy.siblings.each.safe_moon_tokens.count", "after_split"), at("sandy.safe_moon_tokens.kept.count", "after_split"))
assumptions: “Divide ... among her siblings” denotes equal shares, as also implied by the reference to any sibling.

f3_program: collection("girls.math_question_completion_counts", "completed_math_question_count", "fiona_shirley_kiana", source("all three girls complete in 2 hours"))
observe(at("fiona.math_questions.completed.count", "hour_1"), 36, "count", source("Fiona completed 36 math questions in an hour"))

multiple(at("shirley.math_questions.completed.count", "hour_1"), at("fiona.math_questions.completed.count", "hour_1"), 2, source("Shirley was able to complete twice as many math questions within that same time"))

sum_relation(at("fiona_and_shirley.math_questions.completed.count", "hour_1"), at("fiona.math_questions.completed.count", "hour_1"), at("shirley.math_questions.completed.count", "hour_1"), source("the sum of Fiona and Shirley's math questions"))

fraction_of(at("kiana.math_questions.completed.count", "hour_1"), at("fiona_and_shirley.math_questions.completed.count", "hour_1"), 1, 2, source("Kiana completed half of the sum of Fiona and Shirley's math questions"))
same(at("fiona.math_questions.completed.count", "hour_2"), at("fiona.math_questions.completed.count", "hour_1"), source("they each did the same number of questions the following hour"))
same(at("shirley.math_questions.completed.count", "hour_2"), at("shirley.math_questions.completed.count", "hour_1"), source("they each did the same number of questions the following hour"))
same(at("kiana.math_questions.completed.count", "hour_2"), at("kiana.math_questions.completed.count", "hour_1"), source("they each did the same number of questions the following hour"))
member("girls.math_question_completion_counts", at("fiona.math_questions.completed.count", "hour_1"), source("Fiona completed 36 math questions in an hour"))
member("girls.math_question_completion_counts", at("shirley.math_questions.completed.count", "hour_1"), source("Shirley was able to complete twice as many math questions within that same time"))
member("girls.math_question_completion_counts", at("kiana.math_questions.completed.count", "hour_1"), source("Kiana completed half of the sum of Fiona and Shirley's math questions"))
member("girls.math_question_completion_counts", at("fiona.math_questions.completed.count", "hour_2"), source("they each did the same number of questions the following hour"))
member("girls.math_question_completion_counts", at("shirley.math_questions.completed.count", "hour_2"), source("they each did the same number of questions the following hour"))
member("girls.math_question_completion_counts", at("kiana.math_questions.completed.count", "hour_2"), source("they each did the same number of questions the following hour"))
query("sum", "girls.math_question_completion_counts", "two_hours")
assumptions: “Each did the same number ... the following hour” means each girl repeated her own first-hour count.
